independents.name: Independent population-type recruitment
independents.available_now: Current 6.35 unit statistics are present in the upstream unit table and can be joined once population-type membership is verified.
independents.excluded_claim: The available 6.35 inspector extract does not expose a population-type table, so it cannot prove which units each independent province type recruits.
independents.reliable_resolution_route: A version-matched engine population-type export or a published 6.35 reproduction with unit IDs.

special_dominions.name: Arcoscephale dominion scrying
mechanics: Automatically supplies accurate reports for provinces inside the nation's dominion.
Reveals enemy units concealed by Glamour.
special_dominions.disciple_rule: Information is available to disciple players.

special_dominions.name: Mictlan dying dominion
mechanics: Temples and ordinary passive sources do not spread dominion in the normal way.
Blood sacrifice is available and becomes the principal religious expansion method.
special_dominions.disciple_rule: Dying dominion is nation-specific and does not transfer through disciple status.

special_dominions.name: Yomi temple Oni
mechanics: Temples inside Yomi's dominion generate Oni.
Turmoil changes quantity; terrain and temperature change the available Oni types.
At least one friendly candle is required, but higher local dominion strength does not itself raise the temple spawn rate.
special_dominions.disciple_rule: The temple-generation feature does not transfer to disciples.

special_dominions.name: R'lyeh Dreamlands
mechanics: Spreads insanity to non-Void beings.
Generates madmen and can transform them into Void Dreamers over time.
special_dominions.disciple_rule: The effects extend into disciple lands; disciple protection from madness is only partial.

special_dominions.name: Ermor Ashen Empire
mechanics: Kills living population and raises undead replacements.
Detects unburied corpses in covered provinces.
special_dominions.disciple_rule: Population death and obedient undead generation also occur for disciples.

special_dominions.name: Asphodel Carrion Woods
mechanics: Kills living population.
Animates corpses and living remains as Manikins and Carrion creatures.
special_dominions.disciple_rule: The population and animation effects also apply to disciples.

special_dominions.name: C'tis Miasma
mechanics: Creates persistent rain, disease pressure, and wet terrain.
Warm-blooded units without Swamp Survival are vulnerable.
Enemy income is heavily reduced while C'tis receives a smaller positive income effect.
Non-sea land slowly changes toward swamp or drip-cave terrain.
special_dominions.disciple_rule: Disciples are treated like enemies except that their sacred troops are immune; underwater provinces are unaffected.

special_dominions.name: Agartha Golem Cult
mechanics: Constructs receive increased hit points inside the dominion.
special_dominions.disciple_rule: The benefit applies to disciple constructs and also to enemy constructs in the dominion.

special_dominions.name: Additional blood-sacrifice nations
mechanics: May perform blood sacrifices to increase dominion while retaining ordinary passive dominion spread.
special_dominions.disciple_rule: The ability does not transfer to a disciple nation, although a disciple nation that already possesses it keeps it.

special_dominions.name: Phaeacia Dark Ships
mechanics: Phaeacian commanders may sail when both origin and destination are inside friendly dominion.
special_dominions.disciple_rule: The ability does not transfer to another nation; disciple-led Phaeacia can still use it under the master's dominion.

special_dominions.name: Therodos spectral dominion
mechanics: Population slowly dies under friendly dominion.
Friendly forts under the dominion generate ghosts.
special_dominions.disciple_rule: Both effects also apply in disciple games.

special_dominions.name: Mekone dominion conflict
mechanics: Mekone's maximum dominion is counted as one higher when suppressing enemy faith.
special_dominions.disciple_rule: The manual does not state a transferred disciple effect for this rule.

special_dominions.name: Phlegra dominion unrest
mechanics: Every covered province gains unrest each turn.
Higher local dominion strength produces a larger unrest increase.
special_dominions.disciple_rule: In a disciple game the effect operates only when Phlegra is the Pretender nation, then also affects disciples.

special_dominions.name: Dominion-concealed provinces
mechanics: Hides province name and ownership from enemies who have not investigated closely.
A nearby observer sees a false independent province; a scout must enter to pierce the deception.
special_dominions.disciple_rule: Disciples also receive the concealment benefit.
